name: enhanced-search
description: Enhanced search skills for real-time web search, vertical domain search, batch search, and URL content extraction.

interface.shortDescription: Search the web, query vertical domains, batch searches, and extract URL content.
interface.longDescription: Enhanced Search packages anysearch-ai/anysearch-skill as a Codex skill for real-time web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch search, and full-page URL content extraction through bundled cross-platform CLI tools. The AnySearch API key is optional; anonymous access is available with lower rate limits.
